summary: This is the same 0.1.69 release bump, now rebased onto base 6dc09a3. On that base the protocol constants have not changed: workspace client 26 supports [25, 26] (contract.ts:40-41) and control-plane client 5 supports [3, 5] (controlPlaneContract.ts:95-97). No newer release manifest exists, so the previous version (0.1.68) and minimum frontend (0.1.68) still pass the validateRelease.mjs checks by inspection and match releases/README.md; with no executable lines changed, nothing blocks the release.
